question: What screen or touch-response issues do iPhone X reviewers describe?
contexts: Unexpected Touchscreen Issues. While the iPhone X provides numerous features that are improvements over the previous models, it exhibits some problems with touchscreen functioning while the battery is charging. This results in one of two undesired behaviors: 1) Portions of the screen not responding to touch. This is usually in the upper corners. 2) Greatly delayed response to touch such that the screen does not appear to respond at all followed by periods where the screen seems to be under the control of some outside force because multiple actions take place in rapid succession that completely ignore any actual touch commands being made in the moment. Best response is achieved by limiting interaction while the phone is charging.

answer:
One reviewer reports that while the iPhone X is charging, portions of the screen, usually the upper corners, do not respond to touch. [e97889031da1_0]
The same reviewer describes greatly delayed touch response during charging, followed by rapid multiple actions that ignore actual touch commands. [e97889031da1_0]
A reviewer reports the phone arrived with a ghost touch issue where it makes movements on its own without the screen being touched. [26deef7702ed_0]
One reviewer of a second-hand iPhone X says touching one place causes different areas of the screen to be touched at the same time, making typing impossible. [18301d17e72d_0]
A reviewer who received a refurbished unit says the touch screen had a dead area that prevented setting up the phone. [be23d8712de6_0]
Another reviewer describes the touch screen as too sensitive, with typing adding the same letter numerous times. [27c886f7123e_0]
